Typography
Fit

Weight + letter-spacing apply to ALL of the theme's text. Bold on the default Noto Sans is a deterministic faux-bold; a system font uses its real bold face. Font family = any font installed on this machine (themed = per-machine; default Noto Sans = cross-OS-identical).

Layers

Click a layer to select it · the eye hides / shows it on the output · drag the handle or press Alt + ↑ / ↓ to reorder an element. Regions stay at the text layer.
